import java.util.*;

    static final int MAX_LIMIT = 1000000 + 100;
    static final int INF_LIMIT = 1000000007;
    static final int MOD_LIMIT = 1000000007;
    static final int P_CONST = 6151;
    static final int T_CONST = 2000;
    static final int SQ_CONST = 280;
    static final int LOG_SZ = 64;
    static final int LOG2_SZ = 34;

    static int total_numbers, base_d;
    static List<Integer> digits = new ArrayList<>();

    static class Node {
        long[][] matrix = new long[LOG2_SZ][LOG2_SZ];
        long[][] temp = new long[LOG2_SZ][LOG2_SZ];
        boolean[] visited = new boolean[LOG2_SZ];
        boolean[] toggled = new boolean[LOG2_SZ];

        void merge(Node other) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                    matrix[i][j] = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= base_d; k++) {
                        matrix[i][j] = (matrix[i][j] + matrix[k][j] * other.matrix[i][k]) % MOD_LIMIT;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < base_d; i++) {
                if (visited[i] && !other.visited[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                        matrix[i][j] = matrix[i][j];
                    }
                }
                if (!visited[i] && other.visited[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                        matrix[j][i] = other.matrix[j][i];
                    }
                }
                visited[i] |= other.visited[i];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                    matrix[i][j] = matrix[i][j];
                }
            }
        }

        void reset() {
            for (int i = 0; i <= base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                    matrix[i][j] = 0;
                    temp[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void shift(int shift_value) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                    temp[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < base_d; j++) {
                    temp[(i + shift_value) % base_d][(j + shift_value) % base_d] = matrix[i][j];
                }
                temp[(i + shift_value) % base_d][base_d] = matrix[i][base_d];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < base_d; i++) {
                temp[base_d][(i + shift_value) % base_d] = matrix[base_d][i];
            }
            temp[base_d][base_d] = matrix[base_d][base_d];

            for (int i = 0; i <= base_d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= base_d; j++) {
                    matrix[i][j] = temp[i][j];
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < base_d; i++) {
                toggled[i] = visited[(i + shift_value) % base_d];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < base_d; i++) {
                visited[i] = toggled[i];
            }
        }
    }

    static Node[] node_struct = new Node[LOG_SZ];
    static Node[] helper_struct = new Node[LOG_SZ];
    static Node temp_node_struct = new Node();

    static Node fetch_node(int x) {
        int h = x, pw = 1, t_idx = -1;
        while (h >= base_d) {
            h /= base_d;
            pw *= base_d;
            t_idx++;

        x %= pw;

            return helper_struct[h];

        Node res_node = node_struct[t_idx];
        temp_node_struct = node_struct[t_idx];
        for (int i = 1; i < h; i++) {
            temp_node_struct.shift(1);
            res_node.merge(temp_node_struct);

        temp_node_struct = node_struct[t_idx];
        temp_node_struct = fetch_node(x);
        temp_node_struct.shift(h);
        res_node.merge(temp_node_struct);
        return res_node;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 0; i < LOG_SZ; i++) {
            node_struct[i] = new Node();
            helper_struct[i] = new Node();
        }
        int total_numbers_input = sc.nextInt();
        base_d = sc.nextInt();
        total_numbers = total_numbers_input - 1;
        int temp_total = total_numbers;
        while (total_numbers > 0) {
            digits.add(total_numbers % base_d);
            total_numbers /= base_d;
        }
        node_struct[0].matrix[base_d][base_d] = 2;
        node_struct[0].matrix[base_d][0] = -1;
        node_struct[0].matrix[0][base_d] = 1;
        node_struct[0].visited[0] = true;

            temp_node_struct = node_struct[i - 1];
            for (int j = 1; j < base_d; j++) {

        }
        Node final_res = fetch_node(temp_total);
        System.out.println(final_res.matrix[base_d][base_d]);
        sc.close();
